params.information_set: F_t = {x_{i,s}: s + L_i <= t}; disciplined arms shift each series by L_i

lstm.architecture: LSTM at most 2 layers, dropout applied before a linear logit head
lstm.input: 12 months of the standardized aligned panel, x_{t-11:t}, excluding gdp_yoy
lstm.differs_from_approach5: approach5 refits the probit every month; this refits the LSTM every 6 months and reuses the latest refit between refits
lstm.standardisation: at each refit, means and standard deviations are fitted on rows public at that refit origin (<= t); the same scaler is applied at later origins until the next refit, so no data after the prediction origin is read
lstm.validation: the last 18 training-pair months before each refit origin are held out for early stopping
lstm.training_pairs: (window ending s, d_{s+1}) with s + 1 <= origin t
lstm.selection_criterion: lowest mean Brier across 3 seeds on the 36-month tuning block only
lstm.pos_weight: n_neg / n_pos computed on the fitting pairs only (validation block excluded)
lstm.odds_correction: p_cal = p_w / (p_w + w*(1-p_w)), equivalently odds_true = odds_weighted / w, with w=pos_weight; implemented as sigmoid(logit_w - log(w))

leakage_arms.lstm_zero_lag: every series at its reference month, L_i=0, origin-only standardization
leakage_arms.lstm_zero_lag_full_sample: L_i=0 plus full-sample standardization (stronger leakage arm)
leakage_arms.probit: approach5 probit baseline, monthly refit, aligned panel
leakage_arms.probit_zero_lag: approach5 probit specification on the L_i=0 panel

bootstrap.scheme: circular 12-month block bootstrap on paired monthly squared-error differences
bootstrap.premium_definition: Brier(leaked arm) - Brier(disciplined twin) using seed-averaged probabilities; positive means leakage worsens Brier

validation.scheme: expanding walk-forward; LSTM refit every 6 months, probit monthly

latent.model: final disciplined LSTM of the first seed
latent.month_clustering: k-means on standardized hidden states h_t for k=2..6, test months
latent.bridge: Direct ARI between Option A indicator clusters and month-level h_t clusters is undefined. Each indicator is mapped to a vector of Pearson correlations between its aligned series and each of the 16 hidden dimensions over the latest Option A 36-month window (2023-01 to 2025-12); those correlation vectors are clustered with k=9, the k of approach5's latest window, and compared with approach5's latest indicator labels. Both sides then partition indicators.

validation.scheme: expanding walk-forward; LSTM refit every 6 months, probit monthly

rank_selection.criterion: approach5 walk-forward CV nowcast RMSE at month 3 on the tuning block

bridge.construction: Direct ARI between Option A indicator clusters and month-level h_t clusters is undefined. Each indicator is mapped to a vector of Pearson correlations between its aligned series and each of the 16 hidden dimensions over the latest Option A 36-month window (2023-01 to 2025-12); those correlation vectors are clustered with k=9, the k of approach5's latest window, and compared with approach5's latest indicator labels. Both sides then partition indicators.

latent.note: Option A partitions indicators; month-level h_t clusters partition months, so their direct ARI is undefined.

limitations: NBS PMI has L_i=0 in both lag arms and the label is built from PMI, which limits the measured lag leakage premium.
The final LSTM embeds test months in-sample because it is trained through 2026-09; latent results are descriptive.

post_hoc.note: Post-hoc work done after the test block had already been seen. Selection used only the tuning block; test metrics are reported for transparency and are not used to choose models.

protocol.validation_scheme: expanding split: all training pairs before the refit origin, with the last 36 training-pair months held out for validation
protocol.validation_reason: 18-month blocks contained single-class and very small-positive validation samples
protocol.selection_criterion: lowest mean Brier across 3 seeds on the 36-month tuning block only
